english: and according to Your own heart
but that according to the kindness
to Him who [ought] to be feared
and a search has been made
He will cause to come near
that you should take notice of me
to those who plucked out the beard
wherever there was a clear space on
and I will make you swear
And will cause to be heard
I will cause you to hear
and I will let them hear
and as soon as we heard [these things]
and I caused them to hear it
and indeed I shall observe it
for as the fear of You
is it because of your fear of Him
that You are mindful of him
and You have caused to draw near
and I will cause him to draw near
and who cause to come near
and as soon as you are up early
you shall regard as an abomination
